## settings   
Open the command palette:  either `F1` or `ctrl`-`shift`-`P`

settings.json can be accessed from command palette, "open settings"  , "open user settings.json"

file location: 
%APPDATA%\Code\User\settings.json

## extension    

### SQLtools    

pour formatter sql.  J'ai mis ça dans mon settings.json:  
```
   "[javascript]": {
        "editor.defaultFormatter": "esbenp.prettier-vscode"
    },
    "[typescript]": {
        "editor.defaultFormatter": "esbenp.prettier-vscode"
    },
    "[json]": {
        "editor.defaultFormatter": "esbenp.prettier-vscode"
    },
    "[sql]": {         "editor.formatOnSave": true,         "editor.defaultFormatter": "mtxr.sqltools"     },
```
